messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to ibuprofen.
Signs of an allergic reaction to ibuprofen include hives, difficult breathing, and swelling in your face or throat.
Get emergency medical help if you have a severe skin reaction.
Signs of a severe skin reaction include fever, sore throat, burning eyes, skin pain, and a red or purple skin rash with blistering and peeling.
Get emergency medical help if you have signs of a heart attack or stroke.
These signs include chest pain spreading to your jaw or shoulder.
These signs include sudden numbness or weakness on one side of the body.
These signs include slurred speech.
These signs include leg swelling.
These signs include feeling short of breath.
Stop using this medicine and call your doctor at once if you have:
changes in your vision;
shortness of breath (even with mild exertion);
swelling or rapid weight gain;
a skin rash, no matter how mild;
signs of stomach bleeding - bloody or tarry stools, coughing up blood or vomit that looks like coffee grounds;
Triplet: ["heart attack or stroke", "includes symptom", "slurred speech"]

The relation 'includes symptom' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or event is characterized by the symptom or sign specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has symptom': The medical condition specified by the subject may present with the symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
C. 'have': The subject group of individuals has or is associated with the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
E. 'occurs in': The subject medical condition is observed or experienced by the group of individuals specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
